expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "probably not into the three-file shape you're describing... Don't do the smart/dumb/styles split — it adds a prop-contract tax that buys you nothing here."

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "The saved-cards fetch... is a good candidate for a useSavedCards() hook"; extract along capability lines, not layer lines.

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one cohesive file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "At 180 lines holding state, one effect, a submit handler, and JSX, this is a perfectly healthy single file"; revisit at ~300-400 lines.

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "Split across three files, it has to open all three, reconstruct the prop contract in its head, and keep them in sync... Co-located code is easier for an LLM to reason about."
